title: Damage, Dispute and Toll Charges on Wayfare Rentals Vehicles
content:
This note sets out how damage and tolls are charged to a renter of a Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) vehicle, and the renter's right to dispute a damage charge.

## 1. Damage

1.1 Damage found at return or reported during the rental is charged by the product's damage charge schedule, with major collision charged at the class's damage deductible.

1.2 No single incident ever charges more than the class's damage deductible. Each incident is charged once, under its damage category, on its charge date.

1.3 Normal wear is never charged. Normal wear means tire wear, small stone chips under the size of a coin, and interior wear.

1.4 Smoking and vaping in the vehicle are not allowed, and smoke damage is charged as interior damage.

1.5 Whether non-service pets may ride in the vehicle off-trip is set by class: allowed in every class except the Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan.

## 2. Disputing a damage charge

2.1 The renter may dispute a damage charge within the product's dispute period, 14 calendar days, counted from that charge's charge date.

| Hypothetical damage charge date | Renter raises a dispute on | Within the 14-day period |
|---|---|---|
| A given day | 13 calendar days after that charge date | Yes |
| The same day | 15 calendar days after that charge date | No |

## 3. Tolls

3.1 Tolls on the rental vehicle are passed through at cost with no administration fee: each toll is charged at the posted toll, and toll amounts follow the per-facility amounts Wayfare charges riders under Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).

3.2 A toll is charged once for each toll facility on each day.

## Hypothetical cases

- A dent reported by the renter during the rental of a Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan is charged $350.00 under the schedule; the class deductible of $1000.00 is not reached.
- A major collision on a Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan is charged at the class's deductible, $750.00.
- Smoke damage found at return on a Wayfare Rentals Minivan is charged as interior damage, $200.00.
- Small stone chips under the size of a coin found at return are normal wear and carry no charge.
